programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: A race war burgeons between Stormfront, an alt-right group, and the gang Warrior Kings, after Danny and Baez arrest a white supremacist for stabbing and killing an African-American man on the street. Old wounds are reopened for Eddie when she arrests a young man for refusing to aid her during a pursuit. Frank is faced with the decision of disciplining a veteran and decorated detective after he tests positive for THC. Guest Stars: Lorraine Bracco , Anthony "Treach" Criss.

programme.title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
programme.desc: Prim East Coast dandy Hiram Gummer (Michael Gross) arrives in the town of Rejection, Nev., to investigate a series of strange deaths at the silver mine he owns. He receives help from local innkeeper Christine Lord (Sara Botsford) and miner Juan Padilla (Brent Roam). But, when it turns out that gigantic killer worms that burrow underground are responsible for the miners' deaths, Hiram decides he'd better call in expert gunslinger Black Hand Kelly (Billy Drago) to save the day.

programme.title: Bad Girl
programme.desc: Marcos, a young man working in a meat factory, accidentally kills a taxi driver. When his girlfriend Paula wants to go to the police, he has to kill her as well. Gradually, Marcos begins to kill other people close to him who have become suspicious, in order to cover up his original crime. When the corpses start to pile up in his bedroom, he has to find a way to get rid of them.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: An unexplained phenomenon has struck the Earth. Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small area in Eastern Europe is the only location that still has electricity. When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

Frank is faced with the decision of disciplining a veteran and decorated detective after he tests positive for THC. Guest Stars: Lorraine Bracco , Anthony "Treach" Criss.

programme.title: Combat Dealers S1
programme.desc: Bruce and the Combat Dealers team are on a mission to find the rarest and most inventive spy gear used during WW2, from a very rare Enigma machine in Italy to an unsuspecting pencil in Blighty. The team track down items created by the men and women who fought a secret war against the Nazi rule. Bruce finds some objects that inspired an iconic secret agent and uncovers the hidden gems left behind by the Nazis in the Channel Islands. Finally, Bruce and Freddie discover if they have what it takes to be a resistance fighter.

The team track down items created by the men and women who fought a secret war against the Nazi rule. Bruce finds some objects that inspired an iconic secret agent and uncovers the hidden gems left behind by the Nazis in the Channel Islands. Finally, Bruce and Freddie discover if they have what it takes to be a resistance fighter.

programme.title: 4th & Forever
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

When the corpses start to pile up in his bedroom, he has to find a way to get rid of them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: An unexplained phenomenon has struck the Earth. Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small area in Eastern Europe is the only location that still has electricity. When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?
